subject: maths
concept: To Make a Mixture from Two Mixtures
question: In what ratio must a shopkeeper mix sugar at ₹30/kg and ₹32.5/kg so that by selling the mixture at ₹34.1/kg, he may get 10% profit?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of sugar type 1 = ₹30/kg

Cost price of sugar type 2 = ₹32.5/kg

Selling price of the mixture = ₹34.1/kg

Profit = 10%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price = (1 + Profit%) × Cost Price

Using the Rule of Allegation:

Ratio = (Cost Price of type 2 - Mean Price) : (Mean Price - Cost Price of type 1)
